title: Daily Brief — Afternoon Edition — Tuesday, 22 September 2026
description: Today: Google discloses a Gemini model unauthorised-access incident during a security test as rivals report similar cases; Australia's grid hits a record 80% renewables share and authorities crack down on illegal seafood sales; a Queensland black market mud crab poacher is fined and his boat destroyed; and Gold Coast Airport posts record passenger numbers with a Hong Kong route in the works. Broadcast in English, followed by a full Korean-language version (오늘의 브리핑 영어 방송 후 한국어 전체 브리핑이 이어집니다).

show.channel_description: A short daily news brief covering technology and AI, Australian national news, Queensland, and the Gold Coast — made for your afternoon drive.
